verses.text: After the deadly disease, the LORD said to Moses and to Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest,
"Count the whole community of Israel by their families. Count all the men twenty years old or more who are able to go to war in Israel."
So on the plains of Moab, beside the Jordan River across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke to the people. They said,
"Count all the men twenty years old or more, as the LORD commanded Moses." These were the people of Israel who came out of Egypt:
Reuben was Israel's oldest son. The clans that came from Reuben were: from Hanoch, the Hanochite clan; from Pallu, the Palluite clan;
from Hezron, the Hezronite clan; and from Carmi, the Carmite clan.
These were the clans of Reuben. The number counted was forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
Pallu's son was Eliab,

and Eliab's sons were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram, leaders chosen by the community, who rebelled against Moses and Aaron. They were among Korah's followers when they rebelled against the LORD.
The earth opened up and swallowed them along with Korah, and his followers died when the fire burned up two hundred fifty men. They became a warning sign.
But the sons of Korah did not die.
The clans that came from Simeon were: from Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; from Jamin, the Jaminite clan; from Jachin, the Jachinite clan;
from Zerah, the Zerahite clan; and from Shaul, the Shaulite clan.
These were the clans of Simeon. The number counted was twenty-two thousand two hundred.
The clans that came from Gad were: from Zephon, the Zephonite clan; from Haggi, the Haggite clan; from Shuni, the Shunite clan;
from Ozni, the Oznite clan; from Eri, the Erite clan;
from Arod, the Arodite clan; and from Areli, the Arelite clan.
These were the clans of Gad. The number counted was forty thousand five hundred.
Two of Judah's sons, Er and Onan, died in the land of Canaan.
The clans that came from Judah were: from Shelah, the Shelanite clan; from Perez, the Perezite clan; and from Zerah, the Zerahite clan.
The clans that came from Perez were: from Hezron, the Hezronite clan; and from Hamul, the Hamulite clan.
These were the clans of Judah. The number counted was seventy-six thousand five hundred.
The clans that came from Issachar were: from Tola, the Tolaite clan; from Puvah, the Punite clan;
from Jashub, the Jashubite clan; and from Shimron, the Shimronite clan.
These were the clans of Issachar. The number counted was sixty-four thousand three hundred.
The clans that came from Zebulun were: from Sered, the Seredite clan; from Elon, the Elonite clan; and from Jahleel, the Jahleelite clan.
These were the clans of Zebulun. The number counted was sixty thousand five hundred.
The clans that came from Joseph came through his sons Manasseh and Ephraim.
The clans that came from Manasseh were: from Machir, the Machirite clan. Machir was the father of Gilead, and from Gilead came the Gileadite clan.
These were the clans that came from Gilead: from Iezer, the Iezerite clan; from Helek, the Helekite clan;
from Asriel, the Asrielite clan; from Shechem, the Shechemite clan;
from Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; and from Hepher, the Hepherite clan.
Hepher's son Zelophehad had no sons, only daughters. Their names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
These were the clans of Manasseh. The number counted was fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
The clans that came from Ephraim were: from Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; from Becher, the Becherite clan; and from Tahan, the Tahanite clan.
From Shuthelah's son Eran came the Eranite clan.
These were the clans of Ephraim. The number counted was thirty-two thousand five hundred. All these were the clans that came from Joseph.
The clans that came from Benjamin were: from Bela, the Belaite clan; from Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; from Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;
from Shephupham, the Shuphamite clan; and from Hupham, the Huphamite clan.
The clans that came from Bela's sons Ard and Naaman were: from Ard, the Ardite clan; and from Naaman, the Naamite clan.
These were the clans of Benjamin. The number counted was forty-five thousand six hundred.
The clan that came from Dan was: from Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were the clans of Dan.
All the Shuhamite clans together numbered sixty-four thousand four hundred.
The clans that came from Asher were: from Imnah, the Imnite clan; from Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; and from Beriah, the Berite clan.
The clans that came from Beriah were: from Heber, the Heberite clan; and from Malchiel, the Malchielite clan.
Asher also had a daughter named Serah.
These were the clans of Asher. The number counted was fifty-three thousand four hundred.
The clans that came from Naphtali were: from Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; from Guni, the Gunite clan;
from Jezer, the Jezerite clan; and from Shillem, the Shillemite clan.
These were the clans of Naphtali. The number counted was forty-five thousand four hundred.
The total number of the men of Israel counted was six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
The LORD said to Moses,
"Divide the land among these tribes as their own, according to the number of names counted.
Give a larger share of land to a larger tribe and a smaller share to a smaller tribe. Each tribe will receive land according to the number of people counted.
But the land must be divided by casting lots. Each ancestral tribe will receive its share by the names of their tribes.
Each share will be divided by lot among the larger and smaller tribes."
These were the clans of the Levites that were counted: from Gershon, the Gershonite clan; from Kohath, the Kohathite clan; and from Merari, the Merarite clan.
These were also Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, and the Korahite clan. Kohath was the father of Amram.
Amram's wife was Jochebed, a descendant of Levi, born into Levi's family in Egypt. She gave Amram two sons, Aaron and Moses, and a daughter, their sister Miriam.
Aaron was the father of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered the LORD a fire that was not allowed.
The number of Levite males one month old or more was twenty-three thousand. They were not counted with the rest of the people of Israel, because they were not given any land among them.
These are the people counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, when they counted the people of Israel on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan across from Jericho.
Not one of them had been among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest in the Sinai desert.
For the LORD had said about those people, "They will all die in the desert." Not one of them was left, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
